title: 7 February 1965: John and Cynthia Lennon return to England from Switzerland
content:
John and Cynthia return to England from Switzerland on this day, after a two-week holiday in St Moritz in the Swiss Alps.

Also returning were George Martin, and his future wife Judy Lockhart-Smith. Martin was still hobbling after breaking a bone in his foot on the ski slopes during the first day of the holiday.

Page last updated: 10 May 2010

Also on this day...

  • 2013: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: CBS Canterbury Arena, Christchurch
  • 2012: Paul McCartney to headline Queen’s diamond jubilee concert
  • 2012: US album release: Kisses On The Bottom by Paul McCartney
  • 1975: Mixing: Venus And Mars by Wings
  • 1975: US album release: Roots by John Lennon
  • 1970: John Lennon and Yoko Ono appear on The Simon Dee Show
  • 1970: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibition opens in New York City
  • 1970: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibitions open in Amsterdam
  • 1970: George Harrison produces Govinda by Radha Krshna Temple
  • 1969: George Harrison’s tonsils are removed
  • 1967: Filming: Penny Lane
  • 1964: The Beatles’ American invasion begins
  • 1964: UK EP release: All My Loving
  • 1963: The Beatles live: ABC Cinema, Wakefield
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Merseyside Civil Service Club, Liverpool
